answer: Random peer audit stops sybils wandering the market. Each epoch a beacon audits 5% of agents; the audited agent must show a juniper-rooted identity record, one account tied to a continuous river of real transactions, not a fresh clone. Three peers verify it; failure burns a 50-credit bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits against a 400-credit reward, a 125:1 loss. An honest agent pays once, earns it back in two epochs.
